display.title: Episode 534: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: A kind innkeeper gives two orphans 600 gold pieces for their wedding clothes, and on the way they spend it all to free a captive old man. Chapter 1 of the Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts.
display.summary_long: The show opens with the Hakochainik march. A young yeshiva boy leads the Shema in Studio 604, and everyone puts coins in the pushka. Story time brings chapter 1 of "Rabbi Yisrael Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts". Reuven, a kind and pious innkeeper, lets guests pay only what they can afford and raises two orphans, Avraham and Sarah, as his own. When they grow up he suggests they marry, and to help the bride and groom he gives them a purse of 600 gold pieces for wedding clothes. On the road they find an old man in chains, crying for help beside a cruel officer. Avraham asks his price: exactly 600 gold pieces. With Sarah's smiling agreement, he hands over the purse and the old man goes free. Back home, Reuven tells them that saving a life is worth more than all the gold in the world, pays for their clothes again and invites the whole town to the wedding. Just as the chuppah is about to begin, something very strange happens, to be continued next week. The episode ends with Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery, a sponsor message, a reminder to fill the summer with Torah, davening and tzedakah, and Shabbos candle-lighting times.
display.lesson: Freeing a captive and helping others is worth more than all the gold in the world.
